name: @uniacc-chatbot/claude-context
description: Contexto y herramientas para Claude Code - UNIACC ChatBot System

scripts.check-services: curl -s http://localhost:3001/health && curl -s http://localhost:3002/health && curl -s http://localhost:3000 -I
scripts.debug-logs: echo 'Logs del ChatBot:' && tail -20 log_chatbot.txt && echo '---' && echo 'Logs del Dashboard/API:' && tail -20 log_dashboard_api.txt
scripts.pre-testing: npm run init && npm run check-services
scripts.performance-check: echo 'Análisis de performance:' && grep -c 'timeout\|slow\|error' log_chatbot.txt log_dashboard_api.txt && echo 'Timeouts totales encontrados'
scripts.debug-save: echo 'Debugging guardado de prospectos:' && grep -A10 'Guardando\|guardado exitosamente' log_chatbot.txt | tail -20
scripts.monitor-live: echo 'Monitoring en tiempo real:' && tail -f log_chatbot.txt log_dashboard_api.txt
scripts.quick-diagnosis: npm run performance-check && npm run analyze-errors && npm run check-services
scripts.full-context: npm run init && npm run quick-diagnosis && echo 'Contexto completo cargado para Claude'
scripts.test-with-services: npm run pre-testing && npm run test-all-scenarios

author: Juan Pablo Silva
